summary: iter135 Phase 1 backend validation complete: 20/20 pytest cases pass against the live preview backend. New Safety endpoints (Fire Ext attachments upload/download/delete + history.pdf, CA links add/remove/related-resolved with exists=true/false, admin/pm logout) all verified end-to-end including auth gating, R2/inline storage path, 10 MB size limit, and idempotent re-add. Regression sweep on Safety list endpoints (corrective-actions, fire-extinguishers, documents, training-records, overview) all 200. Frontend source-level audit confirms all required data-testid attributes are in place on SafetyFireExtManageDialog.jsx (safety-fe-manage-dialog, safety-fe-history-pdf, safety-fe-att-file, safety-fe-att-kind, safety-fe-att-upload, safety-fe-att-list, safety-fe-att-download-{id}, safety-fe-att-delete-{id}, safety-fe-manage-close) and SafetyCaLinksManager.jsx (safety-ca-links-manager, safety-ca-link-add-toggle, safety-ca-link-add-form, safety-ca-link-kind, safety-ca-link-id, safety-ca-link-submit, safety-ca-link-row-{kind}-{id}, safety-ca-link-remove-{kind}-{id}). Live Playwright login on /safety-portal/login did NOT advance past the login screen after submit even though backend POST /api/safety/login returns 200 from pytest with the same creds — flagged as a possible FE login regression worth a quick manual verify, but cannot confirm without further investigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright fill-and-click on data-testid='safety-login-submit' does not navigate to /safety-portal hub even though backend /api/safety/login returns 200 for the same credentials in pytest. URL remained /safety-portal/login with no visible error message. Could be: (a) FE swallowing 4xx response silently, (b) localStorage write blocked under automation, or (c) form .preventDefault() not chaining to nav. Needs manual smoke test by main agent.

critical_code_review_comments: fire_ext_attachments.py docstring says 'max 5 attachments per unit' but constant is MAX_ATT_PER_UNIT=25 — keep one source of truth; update docstring to 25.
corrective_actions.py uses `id` as query-param name shadowing Python builtin (suppressed with noqa) — works fine, but consider renaming to `link_id` for clarity if not breaking the FE.

fire_ext_attachments.py: R2 degraded-event collection uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (datetime obj) while attachment record uses `.isoformat()` string — mixed type style across the same module; pick one for consistency in audit/query patterns.

Admin and PM logout endpoints return 200 even on exception while writing the audit event (caught silently). Acceptable for client-side logout UX but means missing audit rows are invisible — consider a counter metric.
